verdict.rationale: The pack only glancingly references Figma's component system — a help-center link titled 'Guide to components in Figma' (figma-docs-30) and MCP docs mentioning extraction of 'variables, components, and layout data' (figma-docs-40) and 'sync design system source of truth to and from Figma' (figma-docs-54) — but none of the cited snippets actually describe variants, per-instance overrides, or how overrides stay linked to the master component. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of variant properties, override behavior on instances, and confirmation that overrides remain linked/updatable to the source component.
